full_page.content:
1945, August 7th
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solenuc Carey, O.F ... Cap.
St. Michael's Church 225 Jerome Street Brooklyn 7, N.Y.
August 7th, 1945
Mr. and Mrs. Joseph O'Donnell - Joe and Viney 1120 Lake Shore Drive Chicago.
Dear Friends:
God bless you and yours. Many thanks for kind favor of June 29th. I hope that you are back from your trip to the S.est. that you found things favorable and may you profit in many ways. Hore when I get settled in this new location. Many thanks for your prayers. Please keep them up.
Sincerely Yours in KTO. Fr. Solanus, O.FZI.C
1945, September 26th
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, 0.F.K. Cap.
St. Michael's Church 225 Jerome Street Brooklyn 7, N.Y.
Sept. 26th 1945.
Kr. and Mrs. Joseph O'Donnell 1120 Lake Shore Drive Chicago, Ill.
My Dear Friends:
God bless you and yours. Having noted your kind reques several weeks ago (Aug. 29) I hoped to find leasure for a few details. I've put it off again and again and its the same thing. Ny letters acumulate more and more. At al events I thank you (if I havent done it before anyhow).
I hope those annoying problems in the S.Test have adjusted by this time. We'll continue our prayers that things improve. God bless you again.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
